effects.notes: Immediately after each use of the Major or Minor Improvement board space, the owner may pay 1 food to take that same action a second time (the repeated action keeps its own normal costs).
Immediately after each use of the Minor Improvement board space, the owner may pay 1 food to take that same action a second time (the repeated action keeps its own normal costs).

review.notes: Cost: none. Prereq: none. Printed points: 0. Ban: none. Own-word summary of the third-party wiki effect: right after taking the Major or Minor Improvement action, or the Minor Improvement action, the owner may immediately pay 1 food to take the same action once more. Space names follow the A095 grant_action vocabulary ('major_or_minor_improvement', 'minor_improvement'); sources name the two board actions explicitly. Sources state 'each time you take the action' without restricting it to the board spaces; card-granted variants of these actions are source-silent and not modeled here. Classification (docs/all-cards-classification-final.md, PR #377 source): stage outside, single site, same action re-executed after the improvement action (TR-SITE, DEC). Sources: BGA wiki JA page and English list row, cross-checked; not official Lookout verification.
